name: wmkf_potentialreviewers-address-trust
_comment: S391 additive reviewer-address trust state. This is a bounded, server-owned current-state bundle, not an event log. Null, malformed JSON, an unknown version, or an email mismatch grants no authority. The field must be deployed before code that includes it in a Dataverse $select. Deploy only after the read-only metadata preflight: node scripts/preflight-reviewer-address-trust-field.mjs --target=prod; then node scripts/apply-dataverse-schema.js --target=prod --wave=17-reviewer-address-trust --execute.

attributes.description: Versioned server-owned current state binding one exact normalized reviewer email to staff attestation, contradiction, and resolution metadata. Null or invalid state grants no readiness authority.
